highlights.title: Apple’s HomeView could add security camera features
highlights.summary: Reddit user pdfu found hints hidden in the HomeView 27.2 code that Apple could be adding security camera features to its smart home hub. The strings describe a security camera mode with motion detection, live streaming, and recording options, as well as privacy functions.
body: Code strings in HomeView’s software suggest Apple could launch a Secure Video feature soon.

Supposedly, the video feeds will only be visible to members of the home, and will both show an indicator light and play a sound when either someone is watching the camera feed or when it starts to record. Home members will also get a notification anytime settings are changed for the Secure Video mode. It will also include customizable options for what to detect, stream, or record, based on whether you’re home, away, or asleep.

Some wondered why Apple did not allow HomeView to double as a security camera at launch, and the company hasn’t said anything to suggest the features are coming. But, considering how central privacy is to Apple’s marketing, the company may be waiting to fine-tune those features before launch.

highlights.title: 6 Perfect Star Trek Episodes to Watch to Say Goodbye to Patrick Stewart
highlights.summary: Even more significant than the quantity of Star Trek that Stewart made was the quality. Kirk is in many ways a classic pulp action hero. He faces conflicts head on, never afraid to throw a punch or flirt with a sexy alien.
body: Star Trek wouldn’t be the cultural phenomenon it is today without Patrick Stewart. Sure, William Shatner launched the franchise by playing the USS Enterprise Captain James T. Kirk in 79 episodes. But Stewart led the United Federation of Planets’ flagship as Captain Jean-Luc Picard in 178 episodes over seven seasons of Star Trek: The Next Generation, and then returned to the role for 30 more episodes in Star Trek: Picard.

Any list of Stewart’s best episodes will closely mirror a general list of TNG ’s best moments. Stewart brought incredible gravitas to the show’s most emotionally brutal scenes and gentle humor to its silliest scenarios. Stewart’s death is devastating, but TNG already taught fans how to deal with loss and embrace the best parts of life. Celebrate Stewart by reliving some of his finest moments in TNG ’s six best Picard episodes.

highlights.title: Savannah Guthrie Shares New Post Asking for Information About Her Mother’s Disappearance: ‘We Ache for Her, We Cry Out for Answers’
highlights.summary: Savannah Guthrie has taken to social media to urge anyone with knowledge about her mother, Nancy, who was presumed kidnapped in February and has yet to be found, to come forward.
body: “The world goes on, things appear ‘normal’ – as we try to keep going and be strong, especially for our young kids – but it’s not and it never will be,” Guthrie’s caption continued. “For Annie and Tommy, for Cam and Kristine, for Mike and me and for all of mom’s beloved grandchildren: we ache for her, we cry out for answers, we cannot move forward. We need someone to help us, tell us what you know. Our mom was a light in this world. We want to celebrate her and give her the dignity she deserves. The reward is still available. Please. We are begging you. Please help us.”
She concluded: “Thank you to all those who have been kind and shown the best of humanity. Join us in praying without ceasing.”

In August, Guthrie shared a post to commemorate 6 months since her mother was kidnapped. “We have lived every moment, every breath, and every heartbeat in agony and despair ever since,” she wrote. “Every day, we wake up and try to be strong and go on — because that’s what our joyful and resilient Mom taught us to do.”

highlights.title: Doom Creator John Romero Revives Xbox-Canceled Game At New Publisher
highlights.summary: The fate of the next game from Doom creator John Romero was in jeopardy after Xbox canceled the project last year. Thankfully, Romero confirmed in a new interview that the project will see the light of day, as his studio has found another publisher.
body: John Romero and his wife, game designer Brenda Romero, founded Romero Games over a decade ago and have made Gunman Taco Truck, Empire of Sin, and Sigil episodes in Doom + Doom II. The studio planned to make the jump to AAA shooter development with help from Xbox Game Studios, but Xbox dropped the project during its mass layoffs in 2025. Romero Games had to lay off more of its developers in turn.

In a recent interview with Video Games Chronicle, John Romero revealed more about the project's journey and confirmed that he was finally able to rehire some of the developers he had to lay off. Romero Games downscaled from 110 developers to just 5 initially, as they couldn't find funding. They still owned all the IP related to the project and eventually found someone to pick it back up.

"I just contacted somebody that I knew, and we basically did a deal, and so we have a new publisher," Romero revealed before admitting he "can't say anything about who it is, or when the announce is, or any of that stuff."

highlights.title: A fully playable version of Portal prequel F-Stop leaked
highlights.summary: Leakers have pieced together a playable version of the canceled Portal prequel F-Stop. Most of the assets came from the massive 12-terabyte leak that dropped this August.
body: Nearly 20 years after it was canceled, the camera-based Portal prequel F-Stop is no longer lost media.

Some dialog and elements of F-Stop eventually found their way into Portal 2. But it differs dramatically from the mainline Portal games in that it’s built around a camera mechanic that lets you capture an item by taking its picture and place it elsewhere using the resulting Polaroid-like photos. It’s not unlike Viewfinder in that way.

The game is short, with videos showing off its full campaign all clocking in at under an hour. That’s not terribly surprising, though. F-Stop was developed as part of the “Directed Design Experiments,” a three-month period in 2007 when Valve broke into five teams to build new video game experiments.

highlights.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
highlights.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
body: New research shared exclusively with Kernel Panic shows that hackers have started adding AI functionality into a new strain of infostealer malware, making it possible for the system to automatically profile victims and quickly surface the highest value targets and their information. Dubbed “Volta-Autodoxer” because of how the malware refers to itself internally, the finding by Cisco Talos researchers sheds light on the ways that commercial LLMs are being used to augment and enhance the capabilities of established types of malware.

“Volta is pretty mature as a stealer. It casts a pretty wide net for what it collects,” says Ryan Fetterman, a security researcher at Cisco Talos. “It compiles all of those things together, ultimately producing a serialized dossier that it can send to a couple LLM models. It’s asking the model to act like an intelligence analyst and produce structured citation-backed assessment of the victim. It’s like a prioritization and analysis function.”

Talos flagged the malware using its new CAIRN framework, built to identify hacking tools that incorporate AI capabilities. Fetterman notes that Talos did not track whether Volta has been used in the wild.

highlights.title: Footage of a Persona 1 remake has seemingly leaked online
highlights.summary: Almost two minutes of footage from what appears to be a remake of the original Persona has leaked online.
body: The clip, which seemingly gives the remake the subtitle Be Your True Mind, was shared on the GamingLeaksAndRumours subreddit. It was uploaded to file-sharing site Gofile on 31st October under a Japanese filename that translates as "Megami Ibunroku Persona Remake".

Interestingly, the footage looks a lot like Atlus' more recent entries. It shows off stylish menus and a brief look at combat that closely resembles Persona 5 and Persona 3 Reload. There's also a short social link cutscene in a noticeably different, almost graphic novel art style.

Fans digging through the clip believe they have spotted several details that lend it credibility. These include what looks like Unreal Engine debug text in the top left corner during battle (Atlus switched to Unreal Engine for Persona 3 Reload), a new remix of the original PlayStation game's Pandora theme, and the protagonist being referred to as "Boy With Earring", which is how he is named in Persona 2: Eternal Punishment.
Atlus has not announced a Persona 1 remake, and we can't verify the footage, so treat all of this with the usual caveats.

highlights.title: Forget maxxing your life. 2027 must be the year we relax – and start minning | Polly Hudson
highlights.summary: Maxxing is selfish, desperately try-hard and often futile. Instead of pushing your endeavours to the limit, minning means doing them less, if at all. Public service announcement: fellow citizens, we have maxxmaxxinged.
body: Maxxing is selfish, desperately try-hard and often futile – surely nobody who ever set out to funmaxx achieved it (see: New Year’s Eve), not even Dua Lipa. Minning is much more noble: it’s about making the world, rather than only yourself, better. Instead of pushing your endeavours to the limit, it means doing them less, if at all.

Back in the days when all of this was fields and we only used one x in “max”, it was clear that max volume is too loud, max capacity too crowded, and max power too draining. Somewhere along the way we lost sight of that. Let’s take a deep breath, and enjoy the relief of leaning into minning. First person to suggest they’re doing maxxminning will be taken to the tower and made an example of.

highlights.summary: The FBI says North Korea was behind the massive $6.3 billion crypto heist that hit Binance on October 29th. body: The FBI says that malicious actors from North Korea stole $6.3 billion worth of Crypto from Binance customers.

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) is releasing information advising the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea (North Korea) was responsible for the theft of more than $6 billion USD in virtual assets from cryptocurrency exchange Binance, on or about October 29, 2026. The FBI refers to this specific North Korean malicious cyber activity as “TraderTraitor.”

The FBI, together with partners at the USSS and IRS-CI, has observed TraderTraitor actors converting stolen assets primarily into Ethereum (ETH). It is expected these assets will then be further laundered by converting them using DeFi and instant swap services as they prepare them for further laundering stages.
As expected, Binance reopened customer withdrawals today after freezing them in the immediate aftermath of the hack.

highlights.title: A Persona 1 Remake Is In Development, New Leak Suggests
highlights.summary: Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 aren't even out yet, and another Persona game has already leaked. Fittingly for Halloween, some new footage of an in-development Persona remake emerged online. It appears to be for a remake of Revelations: Persona, the first game in the series.
body: As Persona Central reported, about two minutes of gameplay for the remake emerged online on Halloween. Having watched the footage, it shows the first game's protagonist exploring a school-themed dungeon before entering combat. Tatsuya Suou, the protagonist of Persona 2: Innocent Sin, also appears. The video seems to have been made for an internal presentation, and fans have noticed it reuses some animations from Persona 4 Revival.

If this is real, this remake is likely still several years away from release. I wouldn't expect it to come out until after both Persona 4 Revival, which launches in Feb. 2027, and Persona 6, which does not have a release date. Regardless, this leaked footage suggests Atlus was happy with the response to Persona 3 Reload and wants to remake the franchise's older games in an aesthetic closer to modern Persona titles.

highlights.title: The kindness of strangers: In 1989 I lost a wallet with $1,000 in it. A couple went to incredible lengths to return it
highlights.summary: Cash was king in those days, and that money was enough to last me for a month as I slowly travelled from Australia back to the UK. It was a hot night in 1989 when my wallet – stuffed with $1,000 cash – fell out of my pocket.
body: After university, I left the UK and went travelling in Australia for a year. I saw the delights of the east coast – mostly from various building sites, as I worked my way around doing long hours in the blistering sun. But I loved every minute of it. After 10 months, I had saved enough to make my way slowly back home.
I was enjoying one last night out in Darwin with a gang of traveller friends with whom I was flying to Timor the next day. The intention was to island hop all the way to Singapore.

Cash was king in those days, and the $1,000 I had in my wallet was enough to last me a month on the road. The beers went down easy and I was completely unaware when, at some point in the evening, I lost my wallet. I was still none the wiser when I went to bed to get some sleep before the flight the next morning.
At 1.30am, I awoke to a loud knocking on my door. I stumbled out of bed, bleary-eyed, and opened the door to the hostel manager and an elderly couple – who were holding my wallet.
points: Cash was king in those days, and that money was enough to last me for a month as I slowly travelled from Australia back to the UK.

highlights.title: New York City Marathon: Andreas Almgren wins on debut as Sheila Chepkirui reclaims crown
highlights.summary: Kenya’s Sheila Chepkirui wins second women’s title. USA’s Jessica Jessica McClain finishes in second. Sweden’s Andreas Almgren wins men’s race on debut. Sheila Chepkirui of Kenya won the women’s race of the New York City Marathon on Sunday for the second time, while Sweden’s Andreas Almgren claimed…
body: Almgren was making his debut at 26.2 miles after a successful career running half marathons and the 10,000m. He pulled away from Yemaneberhan Crippa of Italy in the final mile to take the victory in two hours, six minutes and one second. Crippa finished 13 seconds behind. Kamohelo Mofolo of Lesotho was third, edging out defending champion Benson Kipruto.

“I’ve probably never felt so emotional after a race ever,” said Almgren. “With 5k left I felt like I had the legs today … I saw I had a pretty big gap [near the end of the race] and thought: ‘OK, just enjoy these last few hundred meters’, because this is not something a lot of people get to experience.”

Almgren looked to be a veteran over the ⁠distance as he hung in with a crowded lead pack ​through the demanding ​and hilly course. He pulled away ​from the defending champion Kipruto with one mile ​left and had ‌built such a ​comfortable lead by ​the final meters that he jogged across the line, waving his arms as he coaxed more cheers from the crowd.
Chepkirui, who also won the race in 2024, pulled away from her compatriot Hellen Obiri in the final 150m to seal the victory in 2:24.36.

highlights.title: Harry Styles Closes Out 30-Night Madison Square Garden Residency With Two ‘Harryween’ Shows, Dressed as Elvis and Pizza Rat, and a Jalen Brunson Guest Appearance
highlights.summary: Harry Styles record-setting 30-night residency at New York’s Madison Square Garden came to a close over the weekend, with a pair of Styles’ recurring “Harryween” concerts that saw the star, his band and much of the audience dressed for the occasion — in his case as 1970s-era Elvis Presley on the…
body: The themed costumes were not limited to the singer: On Friday, Styles’ band was dressed in his own iconic looks, rocking outfits based on his Coachella, Met Gala and Grammy appearances. “The theme on stage tonight was favorite sequined king,” he joked, later thanking the audience for considering him part of that group. For the encore, the arena was taken back in time as he emerged in his 2010 “X-Factor” audition outfit, singing Stevie Wonder’s “Isn’t She Lovely.” His version of the song was what clinched the then-bakery-worker a spot in One Direction over 15 years ago.

The final show on Saturday was, in its entirety, a tribute to New York City. The band took the stage first, all dressed as local icons including the Statue of Liberty, Andy Warhol and Anna Wintour, before Styles himself appeared as “Pizza Rat,” based on a notorious 2015 meme showing a large rat dragging a slice of pizza down the stairs of a New York City subway station. In another nod to the city, this time in the form of music history, the pop star delivered a compelling cover of Talking Heads’ “Psycho Killer” before reverting to the standard setlist.

highlights.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
highlights.summary: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.
body: Meta’s Muse was among the hottest topics on corporate earnings calls in recent weeks. Meta has claimed that the agentic AI tool, which lets users automate various online tasks, is becoming a major force in shopping, with millions of people using it to make purchases of more than $200 on average.

Wall Street fears that proactive shopping assistants like Muse will erode brand loyalty, ignite price wars, and squeeze corporate profits. Yet on the earnings calls and in conversations with WIRED, executives across roughly 50 companies—spanning travel, internet providers, food, and self-storage—shrugged off immediate disruption. In fact, many insisted they would mostly benefit from any real widespread adoption of agents.

Food delivery app DoorDash described the number of orders from Muse and other agents as in the “hundreds.” T-Mobile remarked, “We haven’t seen anything of significance” from agents. Hotel chain Hilton was more direct, calling bookings from them “insignificant.” The banking provider Ally Financial characterized activity as “quite low,” while eBay termed it “very, very small.”
points: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.

highlights.title: AI is stealing Indigenous Australian art and churning out ‘Temu slop’, artist says
highlights.summary: Chair of National Gallery’s First Nations advisory group says the technology is undermining artists’ agency and the authenticity of their work. Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.
body: AI is taking First Nations art and turning it into “Temu slop”, the Pitjantjatjara artist Sally Scales has said.

Scales, the chair of the National Gallery of Australia’s First Nations advisory group, said the technology is undermining the agency of First Nations artists and the authenticity of their work and represents a “a theft” of cultural knowledge.

Despite prime minister Anthony Albanese’s vow to protect Australian creatives from copyright theft, and the attorney general, Michelle Rowland, saying there are “no plans to weaken copyright protections”, AI has already been trained – without compensation –on the works of well known Australian artists including Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave.

But experts are particularly worried about the risks to Indigenous cultural and intellectual property (ICIP) and in a world where AI companies can hoover up anything that may be found online, including songs and paintings that include sacred and cultural knowledge. AI has altered work, removed names and then been sold, an act the peak body for Australian visual artists said was causing “cultural and economic harm”.

highlights.title: Itch.io Reveals Just How Much AI Slop Is Flooding Gaming Storefronts
highlights.summary: A quick glance at Steam or itch.io shows how gaming storefronts are flooded with new games as more developers use generative AI, making it harder than ever for indie devs with hand-crafted games to stand out.
body: As a gaming website and storefront, itch.io is positioned to be a very indie-friendly platform where almost anyone can sell or distribute the games they are working on. It's full of student-made and game jam projects, but many higher-profile indies are also available through itch.io and often given away in charity bundles. Because itch.io is already a very accessible and useful platform for indie developers, the new data it's shared is all the more concerning.

Late on Oct. 31, itch.io took to Bluesky to reveal that the number of game pages being created each day has doubled since Aug. 2026. According to the graph shared, the number of pages created per day was around 3,000 back then; now, that number is over 6,000 as of Oct. 30. Other replies from itch.io indicate that AI projects make up the majority of these new pages too.

highlights.title: Mobile’s Halloween tricks and treats: Clash of Clans, Talking Tom, Monopoly Go, Fortnite and more
highlights.summary: Halloween is almost here and with it comes a reliable range of mobile games tapping into the spooky season. In-game events, cosmetics and more can be found across all kinds of genres, as can a sizeable helping of pumpkins, witches and autumnal scenery.
body: Whether it’s Pokémon Sleep turning towards nightmarish ghosts like Gengar, or a growing cast of horror characters in Fortnite, there’s a good chance one game or other will land a scare.

This year, Epic Games, Zynga, The Pokémon Company, Scopely, Intelligent Systems and even The New York Times are among those dressing up their games for the occasion. Many of them also recently landed among our Top 50 Mobile Game Makers of 2026.

The aptly named Fortnitemares event has brought a month of cursed content to Epic Games’ flagship, tapping into a lineup of characters like Freddy Krueger, Ghost Face and Freddy Fazbear. In fact, characters from the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe are going all-in on the fright factor, with their outfits able to show battle damage.

Other IPs trickling in throughout October have included Hollow Knight, Slender Man, Beetlejuice and Obsession. Meanwhile, gameplay has seen players firing pumpkin rockets, teleporting around and dropping into Reload’s Nitemare Island.
